### Fixed
- **A rolling muster takes traffic only once it can mint tokens.** The chart's readiness probe read `/health`, which answers 200 while OIDC discovery is still pending, so a new pod joined the Service and the old one was stopped while the new one still answered every `/oauth/token` with `503 service_unavailable` ("OIDC discovery in progress") -- a burst of failed exchanges for every client at once, the Developer Portal's cluster-token exchange across all installations included. The new `/readyz` answers 503 until discovery succeeds and the chart's readiness probe uses it; `/health` stays the liveness probe and keeps answering 200, so a Dex outage still does not restart the pod. ([giantswarm/giantswarm#37348](https://github.com/giantswarm/giantswarm/issues/37348))
